title: Italian Tiramisu Cheesecake
description: A creamy Italian-inspired dessert featuring cheesecake and tiramisu layers.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth.
Add the ricotta cheese, mascarpone cheese, sugar, and eggs to the bowl.
Mix until well combined and smooth.
Add the cocoa powder, espresso powder, and vanilla extract to the bowl.
In a separate bowl, dip the ladyfingers in a mixture of coffee and sugar.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of ladyfingers.
Pour the cheesecake mixture over the ladyfingers.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of ladyfingers.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until set.
